response.justification: Candidate is a current Staff Software Engineer with hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, plus prior experience building low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, aligning well with the AI-native mindset and distributed-systems requirements. However, Python is entirely absent from the skills list and work history (TypeScript/Node.js dominates), which is a stated must-have, and there's no explicit evidence of on-call/incident response ownership or formal agile/scrum ceremony experience.
strengths: Direct current experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, matching the AI-native mindset requirement
Proven distributed, high-throughput systems experience (millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic) with low-latency async I/O expertise
Broad full-stack, cross-domain systems thinking (web, mobile, embedded, GIS) plus founder experience bridging product and engineering
concerns: No evidence of Python proficiency anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being an explicit must-have
No explicit mention of on-call rotations, incident response, or operational monitoring ownership
Career shows many short/varied engagements and freelance work, raising questions about depth of sustained ownership at scale versus breadth

key_factors.factor: Current AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling work
